keyword: what time does the stock market open
claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) opens at 9:30 a.m. ET, Monday through Friday.
Regular trading hours for the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET.
Pre-market trading typically begins at 4:00 a.m. ET and runs until 9:30 a.m. ET.
After-hours trading runs from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on most federal holidays.
There are 10 main trading holidays in 2026 for the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq).
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) closes early at 1:00 p.m. ET on certain days like Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving.
